question: A6: stops.json rules, thresholds, exit codes (chadlis/agentkit#7)
option: budget-reached@1 on the last dev run; failed-share@1 when failed/(produced+failed) > 0.2, missing excluded; both exit 3, dev only

question: A6 review: the process marker and the level pr (chadlis/agentkit#21)
option: The process marker is a guard against accidental HUMAN writes, not a wall; level pr is cited, form-checked offline, unverified; docs say so before merge; conductor marker file follows.

question: A7: how the conductor gets dev scores (chadlis/agentkit#8)
option: Conductor runs Hypotrail import/assess/compare on dev, reads only the Comparison delta, applies keep-higher-dev-score@1; scripted fixtures only; note in ledger/conductor/

question: Record the owner's relayed-words rule?
words: Un agent peut enregistrer mes décisions comme mots relayés : mes mots exacts, copiés depuis un message que j'ai écrit, avec sa source. C'est un niveau de preuve inférieur à HUMAN, et il est affiché comme tel. Ces mots relayés ouvrent la porte de cadrage de mlkit.
